how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD Website (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec).
Fill out the form completely with information regarding educational qualifications indicating percentage of marks/division, details of work experience, etc.
Send the completed application form by email to Prof. Parvendra Kumar at email id: [email protected].
Ensure the advertisement number IITD/IRD/277/2026 is mentioned on the subject line of the email.
Submit the application by email on or before 23/10/2026 by 5.00 p.m.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Junior Research Fellow at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi)
Towards trusted-node-free hybrid quantum secure communication networks (Sub-project under RP04940) (M103131G_SN)

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow post under the Optics and Photonics Centre.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow post must hold an M.Sc. degree with first class in Physics/Optics/Electronics and NET/GATE qualification. Experience in quantum optics/quantum key distribution is desirable. The requirement of NET/GATE examination for the selection to the post of JRF may be relaxed for the candidates who have graduated from Centrally Funded Technical Institutes (CFTIs) with CGPA of more than 8.000 (80% aggregate marks).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The position offers a consolidated fellowship of Rs. 37,000/- per month plus HRA @ 27%. The appointment is contractual, renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, which is up to 29/01/2031.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing of eligible candidates from those satisfying advertised qualification and requirement of the project post. Short-listed candidates will be displayed on web link (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted) along with online interview details. Only short-listed candidates will be informed for online interview.
